# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

Abacate Calendário (`org.onekash.kashcal.tasks`, launcher label `Calendário`, built from `app/build.gradle.kts` and `version.properties`) is an offline-first Android calendar and productivity client that synchronizes iCloud, CalDAV, CardDAV, and ICS feeds, reads and mutates Tasks.org tasks in-place, and schedules departure alerts with travel-time routing.

### Business problem

- Fragments personal and work schedules across iCloud, self-hosted CalDAV servers, webcal subscriptions, contact birthdays/anniversaries, device calendars, and Tasks.org task lists (`README.md`, `docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md`).
- Loses offline edits or silently drops server mutations when sync lacks a persistent operation queue (`PendingOperation.kt`, `CalDavSyncEngine.kt`).
- Misses departure windows for location-bound events without travel-time calculation and live traffic/rush-hour margins (`RoutingService.kt`, `TravelAlarmWorker.kt`).
- Prevents side-by-side installation with upstream KashCal unless the fork isolates `applicationId` (`org.onekash.kashcal.tasks`), Android `AccountAuthenticator` types (`org.onekash.kashcal.tasks` and `org.onekash.kashcal.tasks.contacts`), and launcher shortcuts (`app/build.gradle.kts` lines 50-58, `docs/fork/FORK_INTEGRATION.md`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
| --- | --- |
| User via Android UI (`MainActivity.kt`, `SettingsActivity.kt`) | Views month/week/3-day/day/planner/agenda/search calendars, manages events and Tasks.org tasks, imports `.ics` files, handles `webcal://` and `CalendarContract` intents. |
| Home screen widgets (`AgendaWidgetReceiver.kt`, `WeekWidgetReceiver.kt`, `MonthWidgetReceiver.kt`, `DateWidgetReceiver.kt`, `UpcomingWidgetReceiver.kt`, `SplitAgendaWidgetReceiver.kt`) | Renders schedules and interactive Tasks.org checkboxes on the Android launcher via Jetpack Glance (`app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, `app/src/main/kotlin/org/onekash/kashcal/widget/`). |
| Quick Settings (`QuickAddTileService.kt`) | Launches natural-language Quick Add sheet from the system shade (`QuickAddParser.kt`). |
| CalDAV servers (`OkHttpCalDavClient.kt`) | Two-way event and RFC 6638 scheduling sync with iCloud, Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal, Stalwart, SOGo, Cyrus, Xandikos, Fastmail, Zoho, Mailbox.org, and Purelymail. |
| CardDAV servers (`OkHttpCardDavClient.kt`) | Two-way contact sync with Android `ContactsContract` via `ContactPullStrategy.kt` and `ContactSyncWorker.kt`. |
| ICS / webcal feeds (`IcsRefreshWorker.kt`, `IcsSubscriptionRepository.kt`) | One-way periodic HTTP/HTTPS polling of subscribed `.ics` feeds. |
| Android `CalendarProvider` (`AndroidCalendarProviderRepository.kt`, `KashCalSyncAdapterService.kt`) | Reads/writes device calendars and exposes synced calendars to the OS. |
| Android `ContactsContract` (`ContactBirthdayRepository.kt`, `ContactAnniversaryRepository.kt`, `KashCalContactsSyncAdapterService.kt`) | Reads contact birthdays/anniversaries into local calendars and stores synced CardDAV contacts. |
| Tasks.org ContentProvider (`TasksOrgContract.kt`, `AndroidTasksOrgRepository.kt`) | Reads and mutates tasks, lists, tags, reminders, and places at `content://org.tasks.api/v0` when enabled (`docs/fork/FORK_INTEGRATION.md` §1). |
| Travel routing APIs (`TomTomRoutingProvider.kt`, `StadiaMapsProvider.kt`, `ValhallaDemoProvider.kt`, `LocalHaversineProvider.kt`) | Estimates trip duration for departure alerts in a 4-tier fallback cascade (`RoutingService.kt`). |
| SAF Backup Storage (`AutoBackupWorker.kt`, `CalendarBackupWorker.kt`) | Exports periodic JSON settings backups (`SettingsBackupExporter.kt`) and `.ics` offline calendar backups (`CalendarBackupRunner.kt`) to user-chosen Storage Access Framework (SAF) folders. |

### Macro flow

1. User or intent triggers an action in Compose UI (`MainActivity.kt`, `HomeScreen.kt`) or a Glance widget callback (`ToggleTaskAction`), dispatching to `HomeViewModel.kt`.
2. For calendar events, `HomeViewModel` invokes `EventCoordinator.kt`, which delegates transactional writes to `EventWriter.kt` inside `KashCalDatabase.kt`.
3. `EventWriter` inserts/updates `Event` and `Attendee` rows, expands recurrence rules (`RRULE`/`RDATE`/`EXDATE`) into `Occurrence` rows via `OccurrenceGenerator.kt` (`:icaldav-core`), and appends a `PendingOperation` row for synced calendars.
4. `EventCoordinator` arms exact alarms via `ReminderScheduler.kt`, enqueues `TravelAlarmWorker.kt` (~1 hour before the occurrence) via `TravelReminderScheduler.kt`, refreshes Glance widgets via `WidgetUpdateManager.kt`, and triggers an expedited `CalDavSyncWorker.kt` run via `SyncScheduler.kt`.
5. `CalDavSyncEngine.kt` executes `PushStrategy` (draining `PendingOperation` rows with `If-Match`/`If-None-Match`), resolves `412 Precondition Failed` conflicts via `ConflictResolver`, and runs `PullStrategy` (via `ctag` and RFC 6578 `sync-collection` `REPORT`) to update Room and record `RecentChange` rows.
6. `DisplayEventRepository.kt` combines Room `Occurrence` flows, `CalendarProvider` device events, and on-the-fly `TasksOrgRepository` queries into `DisplayEvent` streams (`Room`, `Device`, `Task`) consumed by `HomeViewModel` and rendered across Compose views (`AgendaListModel.kt`, `AllDayStripLayout.kt`, `PlannerView.kt`, `MonthFullSpanLayout.kt`).

### Out of scope

- Persisting Tasks.org tasks in Room (`AGENTS.md`, `DisplayEvent.kt` — tasks remain in Tasks.org and are queried live via `ContentResolver`).
- Creating or editing subtasks inside KashCal (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md` §1, §8 — subtask counts render on cards, and management deep-links to Tasks.org via `TasksOrgContract.Tasks.viewUri`).
- Displaying Tasks.org tasks that have no due date (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md` §1).
- Creating new Tasks.org task lists from KashCal (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md` §7 — delegates to Tasks.org because the v0 provider rejects list creation on CalDAV accounts).
- Google Play Services (GMS) location dependencies (`TravelLocationProvider.kt` uses AOSP `LocationManager` and `Geocoder`).
- Telemetry, analytics, or intermediary cloud servers (`README.md`, `app/build.gradle.kts` lines 44-47 disable `dependenciesInfo`).
